page.layout: One blank printed page on the left of the scan, with no text. At the right edge a sliver of the facing page shows partly: fragments of a title page in large type (a word ending in "NO", "AN", a large "MAT"-like word, "Quæstio", "in", and at the foot "LUG" and "Officina"). These are show-through or the neighbouring page edge and are not transcribed. The digitiser's credit line at the foot is also left out.
page.notes: The scanned page is a blank leaf with only stains and foxing. The fragments at the right edge belong to the adjacent page and are not part of this page's text. No text is legibly printed on this page, so the main text is empty.
